source_grounded_key_points: Let us Read 2 Gone with the Scooter It was a summer afternoon.
Gopi was sitting in the veranda, reading a book.
Suddenly, he heard something rustling past and falling with a thud in the garden.
Perhaps, it was a mango falling from the tree.
Immediately, Gopi put his book aside, got up, and ran into the garden.
He searched in between the thick grass near the garden fence.
Gopi reached out and took the ball in his hands.
Come inside.” Gopi went inside, and drank a glass of water.
